svg.title: Corrie, tarn, arête and pyramidal peak
svg.desc: A cross-section of a corrie glacier: snow collects in a shaded hollow, plucking and freeze-thaw cut back the steep back wall, abrasion deepens the floor as the ice moves with a rotational slip, and a rock lip forms at the front; after the ice melts a tarn fills the hollow. A plan view shows corries cut back to back forming arêtes and a pyramidal peak.

text.tspan: Plan view: corries back to back
